basic_info.description: Newer construction home taken down mostly to the studs in 2000 and 2001 with foundation seismic upgrades added, new electrical, wiring, plumbing and MUCH, much more. Nestled in the vibrant Lake Street Neighborhood, this beautifully updated Edwardian home offers the perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience. Bordering the Central Richmond and Lake Districts, you'll enjoy easy access to a wide range of amenities, including renowned restaurants, cafes, shops, schools, transportation options, stunning beaches, hiking trails, a golf course, and world-class museums. This spacious and sunlit home features a grand foyer, formal living room with fireplace, open-plan kitchen, dining room, family room, and breakfast nook. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and beautiful countertops. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms, including a primary suite with a walk-in closet, two additional offices, and two full bathrooms. The lower level offers a laundry room, storage space, and a separate one-bedroom en-suite with independent access to the street and yard. Enjoy outdoor entertaining on the private deck and yard. With a 95 WalkScore, this home's prime location in the Lake Street Neighborhood provides easy access to everything San Francisco has to offer.
